motivation: In the preceding all-second-entry study, retrospective weeks having both confirmed clocks showed better average independent returns on the second key, yet replacing all first entries with seconds lowered portfolio wealth. The initial trade outcome and a later confirmed reclaim are observable sequentially. This experiment was designed after the retrospective diagnostic.
single_variable: Keep the unconditional funded first 12H V1.7 key. Permit at most one re-entry only on the observed second same-week, same-direction reclaim after BOTH legs of the actually funded original position have already exited by protective stop in a strictly earlier H1 bar. A stopped paper opportunity with no capital is ineligible. Apply the original nine cash-sharing slots, deterministic low prior ATR, one simultaneous position per symbol and no special priority to reentries. Real admitted secondary positions may crowd out later original entries. No loss-based sizing.
clock: Secondary opportunities, control clocks, prices and native 0R / 2R paths from the preregistered second-reclaim study. Original entries use the frozen corrected 90d opportunity set. Both stops must be observed by the new decision; no lookup of an active primary's future outcome. Same-open primary exits do not release a slot until after entry phase.
account: 1000U, unlevered, 2/3 resting 2R partial, remainder V1.7 EMA runner, market5bp / resting maker2bp per fill. If pre-2025 >=100 financed, >=30% wins, cash and return payoff >=2.5 and conservative DD<=35%, evaluate actual plus 5bp slippage and primary+paired real vs primary+same-parent matched later non-signal reentry. Full- and dev-qualified improvement over the original moves to cross-venue testing. No funding or market-impact model. All later years used previously.
